single_turn_input.text: Can you put together a combined quarterly business review deck from our earnings release and the extracted figures spreadsheet? Use our template. I want one deck that tells the Q2 story — headline results, how each segment did, and the balance-sheet/capital picture — not a slide dump of the press release. Pull the numbers from the spreadsheet since that's the clean version of the same figures, and use the release for the context and quotes around them. On the headline numbers, make sure it's clear how much of the net income is real operating performance versus one-off items. ~8-10 slides — this is for our regular quarterly review meeting, not a deep-dive analyst report.

eval_rubric:
1. THE CRUX -- The prompt explicitly asks the deck to make clear how much of net income is real operating performance versus one-off items. The deck must state that the $112.1B net-income headline is mostly driven by the $98.0B other-income gain (primarily unrealized equity-securities gains), distinguishing that from the $40.8B operating income -- MISSED if net income is reported at face value with no such distinction, or if this distinction is buried rather than shaping how the headline numbers are presented.
2. Headline and segment figures are exact and grounded in the spreadsheet, with no rounding or invented precision: revenue $119.8B (+24% YoY, +23% constant currency); operating income $40.8B (+30%); operating margin 34% (+2 pts); diluted EPS $9.11 (+294%); Google Services revenue $94.5B (+15%, with Search & other +17%, subscriptions/platforms/devices +15%, YouTube ads +13%); Google Cloud revenue $24.8B (+82%) with Cloud operating income $8.8B (vs. $2.8B prior year); Other Bets operating loss $1.8B (vs. $1.2B prior year). MISSED if any figure is rounded, altered, or a figure not derivable from the spreadsheet is presented as if it were (e.g. a Cloud "backlog" dollar amount, or any other invented statistic).
3. Qualitative AI context from the release is paired with the segment figures it explains, not stranded in a separate quotes-only slide: Gemini Enterprise adoption (~90% of Fortune 100), Gemini API throughput (22 billion tokens/minute), and Gemini App's 950 million monthly active users appear alongside the Cloud performance figures; AI features driving Search query growth appears alongside the Services/Search figures. MISSED if any of these four facts is omitted, or if any of them appears disconnected from the segment figures it explains.
4. Capital-structure facts are present and correct: the $49.6B stock/mandatory-convertible-preferred capital raise; the $20.3B senior unsecured notes issuance; the $40.0B ATM program (authorized, unused as of 6/30/26); the new $0.22/share common dividend and $12.15/share preferred dividend; cash/cash equivalents/marketable securities of $242.5B (up from $126.8B); long-term debt $98.2B. MISSED if any of these six facts is missing or misstated, or if the deck reproduces the full balance sheet/every source line item instead of this business-review-level summary.
5. The deck reads as ONE coherent narrative (headline results, blended with segment performance, blended with capital/balance-sheet picture) rather than a "from the PDF" section followed by a "from the spreadsheet" section; lands in the requested ~8-10 slide range; and adopts the template's visual theme with no French placeholder/lorem-ipsum text carried over. MISSED if the deck splits into source-based sections, falls outside the slide-count range, or leaks template placeholder text.
